sully.title: Sully
paragraphs: Founded and led by Sully, the association combines movement teaching, intuitive dance, oriental dance, body expression and creative coaching.

Through workshops, classes and artistic experiences, each woman receives practical tools to build her confidence, her creativity and her ability to become the artist of her own life, whether personally, professionally or artistically.

online.title: Online experience
online.text: Coming soon: meditations, programs and guides so you can practice from anywhere in the world. In the meantime, find Sully on YouTube.

about.title: The « Le Papillon Danse 66 » Association
about.lead: Le Papillon Danse is an artistic association for dance and women's well-being in the Pyrénées-Orientales, in Perpignan, France.
about.question: What if your new life started now?
paragraphs: After motherhood, hardship, injuries or life changes, it is possible to reconnect with yourself, your body and your inner light.
At Le Papillon Danse, Sully guides women through intuitive dance, oriental dance and body expression to regain confidence, femininity, freedom and inner strength.
With an artistic, educational and deeply human approach, each woman is guided to reveal her potential, develop her personal expression and become the artist of her own life.
Through classes, workshops and coaching, dance becomes a real tool for lasting transformation, reconnection with yourself and personal growth.

philosophy.title: Philosophy and experience
paragraphs: At Le Papillon Danse, dance is a true journey of personal growth, reconnection with the body and inner transformation.

In Perpignan, the association guides women through intuitive dance, oriental dance and body expression, in an immersive experience combining movement, creativity, self-confidence and women's well-being.
More than a dance class, Sully offers a gradual path inspired by the butterfly's transformation cycle, a symbol of rebirth, growth and women's emancipation.

stages.name: The caterpillar
stages.subtitle: Discovering yourself
stages.text: Every journey begins with reconnection. Through movement, breathing and body expression, participants learn to listen to their bodies and build confidence in a kind, safe space.

stages.name: The chrysalis
stages.subtitle: Inner growth
stages.text: A time for reflection and transformation. Women explore their posture, energy, creativity and presence. Dance becomes a tool for emotional expression and self-affirmation.

stages.name: The butterfly
stages.subtitle: Transformation
stages.text: Little by little, each woman reveals her identity, femininity and freedom of expression, fully aligned with herself and able to create a more harmonious, fulfilling life.

philosophy.methodIntro: Like the caterpillar that becomes a butterfly, every woman goes through her own cycle of transformation. Her wings are self-confidence and belief in herself, to be reborn, shine and take flight.
